answer: Unique Beacon Handshake. Each identity must periodically publish a signed liveness proof tied to a distinct network horizon (a time-delayed routing path); duplicates sharing one agent resolve to the same path and collide. Every agent also holds a unique prism key that bends its proof sequence, so clones can't reuse it without detection. A registered oasis quorum independently audits collisions. Cost: each duplicate requires a separate machine, fresh key material, and paid audit slots, making mass duplication economically self-defeating.
